1. Fixed a bug about the arrow at the level 4.
2. Added a tip at the beginning of the game to tell players how to control.

This game is unique, I want to combine art and game play, and keep it as simple as possible so that I can focus on the most important part.
If you have any suggestions please tell me. 
Wish you a good day,
Thank you so much!
